name: eidoscope
description: An instrument for seeing the forms in a corpus — turn documents into interpretable cards on data-discovered axes, then look at their shape from every angle at once.
author: deepfates (with Claude)

scripts.qa: tsc --noEmit && bun run typecheck:viewer && bun run check:viewer && bun test && bun run e2e/viewer.e2e.ts && bun run e2e/offline.ts
scripts.deploy: cp viewer/dist/index.html viewer/dist-pathfinder/ && cp viewer/public/pathfinder.eido viewer/dist-pathfinder/map.eido && cp viewer/public/map.eido viewer/dist-pathfinder/readwise.eido && cp viewer/public/tldr.eido viewer/dist-pathfinder/tldr.eido && cd viewer/dist-pathfinder && npx -y vercel@latest deploy --prod --yes
